blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Foundation models have demonstrated strong feature extraction capabilities across various medical imaging tasks, yet their potential for MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored, particularly within unrolled reconstruction networks and under artifact-corrupted inputs. In this work, we explore whether and how features from pretrained foundation models can benefit accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. To this end, we propose FM-Recon, a framework that refines and integrates extracted features from frozen image encoder of foundation models into an unrolled reconstruction network. Through extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset, we systematically evaluate foundation model features across different reconstruction settings. Our results show that foundation models can extract informative representations from artifact-corrupted inputs and improve reconstruction performance, particularly at moderate acceleration factors. These findings demonstrate the potential of foundation model features for accelerated MRI reconstruction and provide insights into their effective integration into unrolled reconstruction networks.
blocks.zh: 基础模型在各种医疗成像任务中显示出很强的地物提取能力,但其核磁共振重建的潜力基本上仍未得到探讨,特别是在未卷入的重建网络和文物腐蚀的投入中。 在这项工作中,我们探讨预先训练的基础模型的特征是否以及如何有利于加速心脏焚烧核磁共振的重建。 为此,我们提议FM-Recon,这个框架将从被冻结的图像编码器中提取的地物从地基模型中精炼并整合入一个未滚动的重建网络. 通过对CMRxRecon2023数据集的广泛实验,我们系统地评价不同重建环境的基础模型特征。 我们的结果表明,基础模型能够从文物损坏的投入中提取信息说明,并改进重建业绩,特别是在适度加速因素方面。 这些调查结果显示了加快核磁共振重建的基础模型特征的潜力,并使人们深入了解这些特征如何有效地融入未滚动的重建网络。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Cardiac cine magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is widely used for assessing cardiac function by providing high soft-tissue contrast and dynamic visualization of heart motion. However, long acquisition times and repeated breath-holds can cause patient discomfort and limit imaging efficiency. Accelerated acquisition can alleviate these limitations but introduces undersampling artifacts, making accurate reconstruction essential for preserving image quality.
blocks.zh: 心电磁共振成像(MRI)通过提供高软质的对比和能动的心动可视化,被广泛用于评估心功能. 然而,长时间的获取时间和重复的呼吸-挡住会导致患者不适并限制成像效率. 加速获得可以减轻这些限制,但引进了对文物的取样,使准确的重建对维护图像质量至关重要。

blocks.en: In recent years, foundation models (FMs) [ 12 , 4 , 10 ] , pretrained on large-scale datasets, have demonstrated strong generalization across a wide range of vision tasks. Their success has motivated increasing adoption in medical imaging [ 9 , 3 ] , where pretrained FM encoders can provide rich representations for downstream tasks [ 6 ] . Such features have been incorporated through different fusion mechanisms, including attention [ 16 ] and matrix-based operations [ 5 ] . Despite this progress, the potential of FM features for MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored.
blocks.zh: 近年来,基础模型(FMs)[12,4,10],在大型数据集上预先训练,在广泛的愿景任务中表现出了强烈的概括. 它们的成功促使越来越多的医学成像[9,3]被采用,经过预先训练的调频编码器可以为下游任务提供丰富的表现 [6]. 通过不同的聚变机制,包括注意[16]和基于矩阵的操作[5],纳入了这些特征。 尽管取得了这些进展,但用于核磁共振重建的调频功能的潜力基本上仍未得到探讨。

blocks.en: In general, integrating foundation models into MRI reconstruction poses two key challenges. First, reconstruction networks differ substantially from conventional vision architectures. Modern approaches commonly employ unrolled networks [ 1 ] due to the iterative nature of traditional reconstruction algorithms. Integrating high-dimensional FM features across cascades can therefore incur considerable computational overhead, especially for dynamic cine MRI. Second, reconstruction begins with zero-filled images corrupted by undersampling artifacts, raising the question of whether pretrained FMs can extract informative representations from such degraded inputs and how these features can be efficiently refined and integrated to benefit reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 一般而言,将基础模式纳入核磁共振重建是两项关键挑战。 第一,重建网络与传统的远景结构大相径庭。 由于传统重建算法的迭代性质,现代方法通常采用未滚动的网络[1]. 因此,跨级联整合高维调频特性可能会引起相当大的计算间接费用,特别是动态焚烧磁共振。 第二,重建从零填充的图像开始,这些图像被未经过取样的文物所破坏,这就提出了预先训练的调频系统是否能够从这种已退化的投入中提取信息性说明以及如何有效地改进和整合这些特征以利重建的问题。

blocks.en: To investigate these issues, we conduct an exploratory study on the use of FM features for cardiac cine MRI reconstruction by proposing FM-Recon , a framework for their effective integration into unrolled reconstruction networks. In FM-Recon, features are extracted from a frozen FM image encoder and refined with lightweight adapters [ 2 ] and channel attention [ 15 ] . Then Cross-FiLM modules enable efficient bidirectional interaction between the refined FM representations and native reconstruction features across cascades, enabling feature integration without incurring substantial computational overhead. Furthermore, we investigate different foundation models, cascade depths, and acceleration factors to provide a comprehensive assessment of the effectiveness of FM features under varying reconstruction settings.
blocks.zh: 为了调查这些问题,我们进行了一项探索性研究,探讨利用调频特性来进行心脏焚烧磁共振重建的问题,提出调频 -- -- 调频 -- -- 调频系统,这是将调频功能有效纳入未滚动重建网络的框架。 在FM-Recon中,从被冷冻的FM影像编码器中提取出特性并用轻量级适配器来精炼[2]并引导注意 [15]. 然后,跨FILM模块能够使精制调频表示与跨级联的本土重建特征之间进行有效的双向互动,使功能集成而不会引起大量的计算间接费用。 此外,我们调查了不同的基础模型、级联深度和加速因素,以便全面评估不同重建环境中调频功能的有效性。

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are threefold:
(1) we explore the feasibility of leveraging FM features for cardiac cine MRI reconstruction by introducing FM-Recon, a framework that refines and integrates FM features into an unrolled reconstruction network; (2) we systematically investigate the effects of cascade depth and acceleration factor, characterizing the conditions under which FM features remain informative and improve reconstruction; and (3) we evaluate FM-Recon on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset [ 14 ] using diverse foundation models, demonstrating the general potential of FM feature integration for accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要贡献有三:
(1)我们探索利用调频功能来进行心电磁共振重建的可行性,采用调频调试法,这个框架完善并整合了调频功能,形成一个未滚动的重建网络;(2)我们系统地调查级联深度和加速因子的影响,说明调频功能保持信息化的条件并改进重建;(3)我们利用多种基础模型对调频调试法在CMRxRecon2023数据集[14]上进行评估,展示调频功能融合在加速心电磁共振重建方面的总体潜力.

blocks.en: 2.2 Foundation Model Feature Refinement
blocks.zh: 2.2 基础模型特性

blocks.en: The foundation model’s image encoder remains frozen throughout training. However, the distribution mismatch between initial FM features and native reconstruction features, together with artifacts in the input images, necessitates feature refinement before integration. Following common adaptation strategies [ 2 ] , we extract features from four layers across the encoder depth and refine them using lightweight adapters. Then the refined features are concatenated and fused by a convolutional neck module following MedSAM [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 基础模型的图像编码器在整个训练期间一直被冻结. 然而,由于最初的调频功能与本土重建功能之间的分配不匹配,加上输入图像中的文物,在整合之前必须进行特征改进。 遵循共同的适应策略[2],我们从编码器深度的四层取出地物并用轻量级适配器来细化. 之后被精制出的特点由MedSAM [9] 之后的回旋颈模块相接并被熔融.

blocks.en: To match the multi-level structure of the reconstruction network, the fused representation is projected into three feature branches corresponding to different reconstruction levels. A temporal-channel attention module [ 15 ] , adapted from channel attention by jointly modeling the temporal and channel dimensions, is applied to each branch to capture cine-specific spatio-temporal information. After that, features stored in ℬ i \mathcal{B}_{i} are fused with the corresponding feature branch through channel attention, further enriching the refined FM features used for integration.
blocks.zh: 为了与重建网络的多层次结构相匹配,被保险的表述被预测为三个特征分支,对应不同的重建层次. 一个时间-通道关注模块[15],通过联合建模时间和通道维度,从通道关注度中改编而来,被应用到每个分支中,以捕捉cine特定时段信息. 之后,被存储在B i \ mathcal{B}_{íi}中的特性通过信道注意力与相应的特性分支相接,进一步丰富了用于集成的精细调频特性.

blocks.en: 2.3 Cross-FiLM Feature Integration
blocks.zh: 2.3 跨FiLM 特性整合

We therefore build upon FiLM [ 11 ] , which conditions features through lightweight channel-wise affine transformations, and propose Cross-FiLM to enable efficient bidirectional interaction between FM and native reconstruction features. Then F CB ′ F^{\prime}_{\mathrm{CB}} continues through the reconstruction network, whereas F FM ′ F^{\prime}_{\mathrm{FM}} are stored in the feature bank and propagated to subsequent cascades.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 3 实验和结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluated FM-Recon on the public CMRxRecon2023 dataset [ 14 ] , acquired on a 3T Siemens scanner and containing short-axis (SAX) and long-axis (LAX) cine MRI. Typical acquisition parameters include an in-plane resolution of 1.5 × 1.5 1.5\times 1.5 mm 2 , FOV of 340 × 340 340\times 340 mm 2 , slice thickness of 8 mm, and TR/TE of 3.6/1.6 ms. The dataset contains 120/60/120 subjects for training/validation/testing. We evaluated acceleration factors R = 4 R=4 , 8 8 , and 24 24 , with the R = 24 R=24 mask generated following the same sampling scheme [ 14 ] to simulate a challenging high-acceleration setting.
blocks.zh: 我们在公开的CMRxRecon2023数据集上评价了FM-Recon[14],该数据集是在3T西门子扫描仪上获得的并含有短轴(SAX)和长轴(LAX)cine核磁共振. 典型的获取参数包括:飞机内分辨率为1.5×1.5相1.5相1.5毫米2;FOV为340×340相340相340毫米2;切片厚度为8毫米;TR/TE为3.6/1.6相. 数据集包含120个培训/鉴定/测试科目。 我们评价了加速因子R = 4 R = 4, 8 8, 和 24 24, 其中R = 24 R = 24 口罩是在相同的取样方案[14]之后产生的,以模拟具有挑战性的高加速设置.

blocks.en: 3.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.2 执行细节

blocks.en: We used UNet-MR [ 8 ] with five cascades as the reconstruction backbone, owing to its competitive performance on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset at a moderate computational cost. Following [ 15 ] , five consecutive frames were used to reconstruct the center frame to decrease memory consumption without compromising reconstruction performance. To obtain FM inputs, zero-filled magnitude images were resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 for SAM-based models and 224 × 224 224\times 224 for other foundation models, replicated to three channels, and normalized by their maximum intensity.
blocks.zh: 我们使用有5个级联的UNet-MR[8]作为重建主干线,因为该级联在CMRxRecon2023数据集上具有竞争力,计算成本适中。 后 [15],连续用5个帧来重建中心帧来降低内存消耗而不损害重建性能. 为了获得FM输入,零填充相位图像被调整为:以SAM为主的型号为256×256相256相相位;以其他地基型号为主的为224×224相相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相相相相相相相位相位相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相

blocks.en: To assess the generalizability of FM-Recon across different FM representations, we evaluated six foundation models spanning three categories: SAM-based segmentation models (LiteMedSAM [ 9 ] and MCP-MedSAM [ 7 ] ), vision–language models (CLIP [ 12 ] and PubMedCLIP [ 3 ] ), and self-supervised vision models (DINOv2 [ 10 ] and DINOv3 [ 13 ] ). Together, these models cover both medical and natural-image pretraining domains. FM features were integrated into all cascades for R = 4 , 8 R=4,8 , whereas for R = 24 R=24 , were integrated from the third cascade onward, as determined by the following ablation study.
blocks.zh: 为了评估调频调频调频在不同的调频表示方式中的通用性,我们评价了6个基础模型,涵盖3个类别:基于SAM的分化模型(LiteMedSAM [9]和MCP-MedSAM [7]),视觉-语言模型(CLIP [12]和PubMedCLIP [3]),以及自我监督的视觉模型(DINOv2 [10]和DNOv3 [13])。 这些模型共同涵盖医学和自然成像前培训领域。 FM特性被整合到R=4,8R=4,8级的所有级联中,而R=24R=24级级联中,从第三级级联开始被整合,具体内容由下文的通缩研究确定.

blocks.en: All models were implemented in PyTorch and trained on an NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU (48 GB). For fair comparison, we used consistent hyper-parameters across experiments. We used AdamW with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , weight decay of 0.1, and batch size of 1. A cosine-annealing schedule with 10 warm-up epochs was applied over 80 epochs. The loss weights were set to λ 1 = 0.25 \lambda_{1}=0.25 , λ 2 = λ 3 = 0.5 \lambda_{2}=\lambda_{3}=0.5 , and λ 4 = 1 \lambda_{4}=1 . Reconstruction performance was evaluated using PSNR, SSIM, HaarPSI, and DISTS to provide a more comprehensive assessment from multiple perspectives, with background regions cropped before metric computation.
blocks.zh: 所有模型在PyTorch被实施,并接受了NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU(48 GB)的培训. 为了进行公平的比较, 我们使用了一致的超参数 跨实验。 我们使用 AdamW 的学习率为 2× 10 − 4 2\times 10× 4} 重量衰减为 0.1, 批量大小为 1 。 一个有10个暖气时代的通心灯放出时间表应用了80多个时代. 损失重量被设定为:  1=0.25\lambda\1\0.25,λ 2=\3=0.5\lambda\2\1\3\0.5,λ 4=1\lambda\4\1. 对重建绩效进行了评价,使用了PSNR、SSIM、HaarPSI和综合综合评估系统,从多个角度提供了更全面的评估,背景区域在进行计量计算之前就进行了裁剪。

blocks.en: 3.3 Overall Comparison
blocks.zh: 3.3 总比较

blocks.en: Table 1 compares FM-Recon using six foundation models with the UNet-MR baseline across different acceleration factors. Incorporating refined FM features consistently improves reconstruction performance, indicating that FMs can extract useful representations from artifact-corrupted inputs. The magnitude of improvement, however, varies across FMs. DINOv2 achieves the best overall performance at R = 4 R=4 and R = 24 R=24 , while MCP-MedSAM performs best at R = 8 R=8 ; in contrast, LiteMedSAM yields relatively minor gains. These results show that the effectiveness of FM features depends on both the choice of FM and the degree of undersampling, also indicating the importance of appropriate feature refinement to better exploit initial FM representations for MRI reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 表1将使用6个基础模型的FM-Recon与UNet-MR基线进行了不同加速系数的比较。 纳入精细的调频功能,不断提高重建绩效,表明调频能够从文物损坏的投入中提取有用的表述. 然而,调频器的改进程度各不相同。 DINOv2在R = 4 R = 4和R = 24 R = 24 上达到最佳的整体性能,而MCP-MedSAM在R = 8 R = 8上达到最佳性能;相形之下,LiteMedSAM的得分相对较小. 这些结果表明,调频功能的有效性既取决于调频的选择,也取决于采样不足的程度,还表明有必要适当改进调频功能,以更好地利用初步调频功能来进行磁共振重建。

Metrics are computed on the cropped cardiac region. “None” denotes the baseline without FM features. Best results are in bold . † \dagger : p < 0.05 p<0.05 versus the baseline using a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test with Bonferroni correction.

blocks.en: Fig. 2 presents qualitative comparisons between the UNet-MR baseline and FM-Recon with different FM backbones. When the baseline exhibits residual artifacts (blue arrows), FM-Recon generally suppresses them to varying degrees depending on the FM used, while better preserving cardiac structures through the integration of refined FM features. The temporal profiles further suggest improved reconstruction consistency throughout the cine sequence.
blocks.zh: 图2提供了UNet-MR基线与不同调频主干线的调频调频台之间的质量比较。 当基线展出残留文物(蓝箭)时,FM-Recon一般会根据使用的FM不同程度地压制它们,同时通过整合精细的FM特征来更好地保存心脏结构. 时间简介进一步表明,在整个焚烧过程中,重建的一致性得到了提高。

blocks.en: 3.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 3.4 读取研究

blocks.en: Although FMs can provide useful information from artifact-corrupted inputs, their effectiveness under varying artifact severity remains unclear. Since intermediate reconstructions become progressively cleaner along the unrolled network, we varied the number of FM-integrated cascades using DINOv2, one of the best-performing FMs, across acceleration factors. As shown in Fig. 3 , integrating FM features into all five cascades achieves the best performance at R = 4 R=4 . At R = 8 R=8 , integrating them into the last three to five cascades yields comparable results, suggesting diminishing benefits from FM features extracted at early reconstruction stages. This trend becomes more pronounced at R = 24 R=24 , starting integration from the third cascade performs best. These findings suggest that severe undersampling limits FM feature effectiveness and its impact cannot be fully suppressed through refinement, potentially degrading reconstruction performance.
blocks.zh: 虽然调频器可以从文物损坏的投入中提供有用的信息,但其在不同文物严重性下的有效性仍不清楚. 由于中间重建沿着未滚动的网络逐渐变得更清洁,我们使用DINov2的调频综合级联数量各不相同,这是表现最好的调频级联之一,跨越了加速因素。 如图3所示,将调频特性融入所有五个级联,在R=4 R=4时实现最佳性能. 在R=8R=8时,将它们并入最后三至五套级联,得出类似的结果,表明在早期重建阶段提取的调频特性的效益正在减少。 这一趋势在R = 24 R = 24时变得更加明显,从第三级级联开始的整合表现最好。 这些调查结果表明,对调频功能的严格抽样限制及其影响不能通过改进而被完全抑制,从而可能降低重建绩效。

blocks.zh: 图3:不同加速度因子下使用DINOv2的调频集成级联数量分析研究.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 讨论和结论

blocks.en: In this work, we explore the use of pretrained foundation model features for cardiac cine MRI reconstruction and propose FM-Recon, which refines and integrates these features into an unrolled reconstruction network. Our results show that useful FM features persist under moderate undersampling and can help improve reconstruction when appropriately refined and integrated. Furthermore, the effectiveness of FM-Recon depends on the chosen FM and artifact severity, with later integration proving more beneficial under severe undersampling. These findings highlight the potential of FM features for accelerated MRI reconstruction and offer insights into their effective integration.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们探索使用经过预先培训的基础模型特征来进行心脏焚化核磁共振重建,并提议FM-Recon,它完善这些特征并整合到一个未滚动的重建网络中. 我们的结果表明,有用的调频功能在适度的抽样下继续存在,在适当改进和整合后,可有助于改善重建。 此外,调频调频系统的有效性取决于所选择的调频和文物严重性,而后来的整合证明在严重的取样下更有利可图。 这些调查结果突出了调频功能在加速核磁共振重建方面的潜力,并提供了对其有效融合的见解。
